notes: the braces «{ ... }» around «عن هشام بن عروة» are the edition's marking of a name inline in the text; read as part of the chain as written
«أبيه» is Abdullah b. Abi Bakr's father, named only by relation (kind relation)
«قالت سمعت عائشة، تقول قال رسول الله» : Amra heard Aisha, the Prophet is the end
